title: Estimated tax for a large corporation — Crestline Corp.
instructions: Crestline Corp. (calendar year) had taxable income over $1 million in 2024, so it is a large corporation. Its 2024 tax was **$400,000**; its 2025 tax will be **$600,000**. It doesn't use the annualized or seasonal methods.

parts.prompt: Compute the minimum installments to avoid the underpayment penalty.

rows.label: First installment (April 15)
rows.explanation: A large corporation may base only the first installment on prior-year tax: 25% × 400,000 = **100,000**.
